result.Method of Attack: Infostealer malware disguised as cryptocurrency miner capable of backdooring systems and exfiltrating system information, environment variables, cloud credentials, and SSH private keys; Trojanized credentials checker used to validate stolen WordPress credentials
Impacted Systems: Systems operated by cybersecurity researchers and offensive actors
Attack Vector: Phishing campaign targeting academics with disguised Linux Kernel microcode patch
Trojanized proof of concepts (PoCs) for software vulnerabilities hosted on GitHub
Indicators of Compromise: Exfiltration of stolen data to file.io and Dropbox
Repositories hosted on GitHub and Codeberg
